lines.en: label chapthree8:
scene clubtime1
: Hah...
: What’s up with you?
lines.zh: : 你怎么了?

lines.en: : Oh...nothing, Sir. Just thinking about how unfair life is and how everything I know is crumbling down around me.
lines.zh: : 哦……没什么,Sir。只是在想人生有多不公平,还有我熟悉的一切正在我周围一点点崩塌。

lines.en: : I feel like that’s...pretty much half of what being a teenager is.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这……差不多就是「当青少年」的一半内容了。

lines.en: : Is the other half impending doom and overwhelming exhaustion?
lines.zh: : 那另一半是即将到来的末日,还有压倒性的疲惫吗?

lines.en: : No. The other half is figuring out the best possible times to masturbate and working your entire schedule around them.
lines.zh: : 不是。另一半是找出最合适的自慰时间,然后围着那些时间安排整个日程。

lines.en: scene clubtime2

: That seems like a lot of self-pleasure, Sir. I don’t think any of us have the time for that level of frequency. And this is coming from someone who is very likely in the higher tier for that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 这自娱自乐的分量听起来可不小啊,Sir。我不觉得我们谁有那么多时间维持这种频率。而这话还是出自一个在那方面很可能算得上高阶的人之口。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see that we’ve finally found something we have in common.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到我们终于找到了共同点。

lines.en: : Whatever’s wrong right now won’t last forever, though. So the best thing you can do is just move past it before it eats away at the half of you that isn’t busy dodging debris from the world crumbling.
lines.zh: : 不过现在不管出了什么问题,都不会永远持续下去。所以你能做的最好的事,就是在它把你身上那一半「没忙着躲避世界崩塌时掉下来的碎块」的部分啃光之前,先迈过去。

lines.en: scene clubtime3
: 'Tis the plan, Sir. And unless you plan on abandoning me again, I’m sure that the brunt of the onslaught has subsided and that things will go back to normal for me shortly.
lines.zh: : 我就是这么打算的,Sir。而且除非你打算再把我丢下,我敢肯定最猛的那阵冲击已经过去了,我的生活很快就会恢复正常。

lines.en: : Or at least as normal as they can be for someone with every class level-capped and a stack of doujinshi under her bed.
lines.zh: : 或者说,恢复到一个所有科目都等级封顶、床底下还堆着一摞同人志的人所能拥有的正常。

lines.en: : I have no idea what that means.
lines.zh: : 我完全听不懂那是什么意思。

lines.en: : It means that I will be forever alone, Sir.
lines.zh: : 意思是我会永远孤独下去,Sir。

lines.en: : Well, I’m sure it doesn’t help considering my inconsistent track record, but you’ve got me.
lines.zh: : 嗯,考虑到我这人一向靠不住,这忙大概帮不上什么,不过你还有我。

lines.en: scene clubtime4
: It helps. Even if you don’t ever understand what I’m talking about...or show any interest in any of the things I like...and get very easily annoyed whenever I talk too much...and-
lines.zh: : 这就有用。哪怕你永远听不懂我在说什么……也对我喜欢的任何东西都不感兴趣……而且我一说多了你就很容易烦……而且——

lines.en: scene clubtime5
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Isn’t that the shirt I made for you?...
lines.zh: : 这不是我给你做的那件衬衫吗?……

lines.en: : You’re...actually wearing it?
lines.zh: : 你……真的穿着它?

lines.en: : It was about time for a change.
lines.zh: : 也该换换了。

lines.en: : Plus, it was very hot this morning and this shirt is surprisingly breathable.
lines.zh: : 再说,今天早上很热,而这衬衫出奇地透气。

lines.en: scene clubtime6
: I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : I have bad news, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我有个坏消息,Sir。

lines.en: scene clubtime7
: Oh?
: Effective roughly ten minutes ago, the manga club lost one of its most dedicated and seasoned members.
lines.zh: : 大约十分钟前生效——漫画部失去了它最投入、也最资深的一位成员。

lines.en: : Haven’t you all been in the club for the same amount of time? How exactly does one become more seasoned than the others?
lines.zh: : 你们所有人加入社团的时间不是都一样长吗?一个人到底是怎么比其他人更资深的?

lines.en: : Attendance, Sir. Rin seldom missed a meeting.
lines.zh: : 出勤率,Sir。Rin 几乎从不缺席。

lines.en: : Ah. So it was her.
lines.zh: : 啊。原来是她。

lines.en: : I guess that makes sense. I heard Otoha talking about some music club or something and figured Rin might wind up joining that instead.
lines.zh: : 我想这说得通。我听 Otoha 说起过什么音乐社团之类的,就猜 Rin 最后可能会转去那边。

lines.en: : This isn’t really bad news for {i}me,{/i} though. It just kind of sucks for you and...whoever else wanted her to stick around.
lines.zh: : 不过这对{i}我{/i}来说算不上什么坏消息。只是对你、还有……其他想让她留下的人来说有点难受罢了。

lines.en: scene clubtime8
: Of course this is bad news for you as well, Sir. You are just as involved with the manga club as I am.
lines.zh: : 这当然对你也是坏消息,Sir。你跟漫画部的牵扯不比我少。

lines.en: : Why? Because my niece is in it?
lines.zh: : 为什么?因为我的外甥女在里面?

lines.en: : Because you are the club advisor.
lines.zh: : 因为你是社团顾问。

lines.en: : I’m the what?
lines.zh: : 我是什么?

lines.en: : The club advisor, Sir. The one responsible for...well, advising us.
lines.zh: : 社团顾问,Sir。就是负责……嗯,指导我们的那个人。

lines.en: : And while it’s true that I have never seen you at one of the meetings...and that none of us have ever really needed your assistance, you are still one of us.
lines.zh: : 虽然我确实从没在任何一次活动上见过你……而我们大家也从来没真的需要过你的帮助,但你仍然是我们中的一员。

lines.en: : I will never be one of you.
lines.zh: : 我永远不会是你们中的一员。

lines.en: : I’m afraid it’s too late for that, Sir.
lines.zh: : 恐怕这件事已经来不及了,Sir。

lines.en: : Even if I {i}am{/i} one of you, which I am not, how is this bad news for me? It’s not like I’m going to miss her or anything since I was never around to begin with.
lines.zh: : 就算我{i}是{/i}你们中的一员——可我不是——这对我也算什么坏消息?反正我从头到尾就没出现过,也不至于会想念她什么的。

lines.en: : It’s bad news for you because, if we’re unable to get one more member by the end of the day, the club won’t meet the cutoff required and you’ll wind up getting stuck as the advisor for another club.
lines.zh: : 这对你是坏消息,是因为如果我们在今天结束前招不到再多一名成员,社团就达不到要求的人数下限,而你会被塞去当另一个社团的顾问。

lines.en: : And while that may not sound {i}that{/i} bad for you considering this is an all-girls school and you are a modern day pied piper for adolescents, {i}our{/i} club is the one that cosplays.
lines.zh: : 虽然考虑到这是所女子学校、而你又是当代的青少年魔笛手,这听起来对你也许没{i}那么{/i}糟,可{i}我们{/i}这个社团是会玩角色扮演的那个。

lines.en: : You’re right. This is a problem.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。这是个问题。

lines.en: scene clubtime9
: So you’ll help me locate a fifth member?!
lines.zh: : 所以你会帮我找第五个成员?!

lines.en: : No. But I will try and find a room to clear out in my house so you’ll still have the time and space required to make outfits.
lines.zh: : 不会。不过我会在家里腾出一间屋子来,好让你们还有做衣服需要的时间和空间。

lines.en: scene clubtime10
: Oh.
: Well, I suppose we are doomed then.
lines.zh: : 那我看我们是完了。

lines.en: scene clubtime11
: Okay ladies...and I guess Senpai since he’s also technically employed here!
lines.zh: : 好了,姑娘们……还有 Senpai,毕竟严格来讲他也是在这儿上班的!

lines.en: : I am literally your boss. I think.
lines.zh: : 我可是你字面意义上的上司吧。大概。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure how student teachers-
lines.zh: : 我不太确定实习老师到底——

lines.en: : Shush! I’m talking to the girls right now.
lines.zh: : 嘘!我现在正在跟姑娘们说话。

lines.en: : If you don’t have a penis, let this be your warning that as soon as the bell rings, you need to head over to your new club for a mandatory day-one meeting.
lines.zh: : 如果你没有阴茎,那就把这话当成警告:铃一响,你们就得去自己的新社团参加第一天的强制集会。

lines.en: : And what about if you {i}do{/i} have a penis?
lines.zh: : 那如果{i}有{/i}阴茎呢?

lines.en: : You’re lucky! Any other questions?
lines.zh: : 那你就走运了!还有别的问题吗?

lines.en: : Will you be advising any clubs? Because if not, you should drop by the archery range and-
lines.zh: : 你会去指导什么社团吗?如果不去的话,你该顺道去弓道场看看,然后——

lines.en: : Miss Watabe has made me promise to not come within a hundred feet of the archery range because she is afraid she’ll “accidentally” shoot me.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师让我保证,绝不靠近弓道场一百英尺以内,因为她怕自己会「不小心」射到我。

lines.en: : Miss Watabe is the archery club advisor?! Why didn’t anyone tell me about this?!
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师是弓道部的顾问?!怎么没人告诉过我这种事?!

lines.en: scene clubtime12
: Because you’re way too horny and she’s already spoken for! Any {i}other{/i} questions? We should have time for one more.
lines.zh: : 因为你太饥渴了,而她已经名花有主了!还有{i}别的{/i}问题吗?我们应该还来得及再回答一个。

lines.en: : Where did you get your bow?
lines.zh: : 你的弓是从哪儿买的?

lines.en: scene clubtime13
: Les Vêtements!
lines.zh: : Les Vêtements!

lines.en: : I knew it! You should come by again! We’ve got-
lines.zh: : 我就知道!你该再来一趟!我们还有——

lines.en: : Kumon-mi High student handbook! Page 13! Section B! No advertising in class!
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 高中学生手册!第 13 页!B 节!课堂上禁止打广告!

lines.en: : Actually, Miss Imai, Chika’s allusion to a part time job would take priority over the aforementioned advertisement rule as it’s a much greater offense and-
lines.zh: : 实际上,Imai 老师,Chika 暗示的兼职工作应当优先于上述广告规定,因为那是更严重的违规行为,而且——

lines.en: scene clubtime14
: Imani Imai’s personal self-made handbook! Page 1! Section A! If your name is Makoto, shut up!
lines.zh: : Imani Imai 自制的私人手册!第 1 页!A 节!如果你叫 Makoto,就闭嘴!

lines.en: : Hah...
scene clubtime15
: Alright, girls! Class is dismissed! Now go do the thing or we’re all going to be sacrificed to whoever Yasu’s god is!
lines.zh: : 好了,姑娘们!下课!现在该干嘛干嘛去,不然我们全都要被献祭给 Yasu 的那位神了!

lines.en: : Praise be!
lines.zh: : 赞美他!

lines.en: : Praise be, indeed! Whatever that means!
lines.zh: : 赞美他,没错!管它是什么意思!

lines.en: scene black
One by one, the girls filter out of the classroom, leaving behind nothing but a few scattered personal belongings and the idea that, slowly but surely, life is changing.
lines.zh: 女孩们一个接一个地走出教室,留下的只有几件散落的私人物品,以及一个念头——慢慢地、但确确实实地,人生正在改变。

lines.en: scene clubtime16

It might not be in an exciting way. In fact, it might not be much of a change at all for someone like me who, if you take away the constant restarting of the world and all of the taboo sex, lives a pretty normal life.
lines.zh: 也许不是以什么令人兴奋的方式。事实上,对于像我这样的人来说,如果把世界不断重启这件事、以及所有那些禁忌的性事都拿掉,我过的其实是相当正常的生活,所以这也许根本算不上什么改变。

lines.en: But for a certain someone who still, one day later, clings to the walls of my mind...
lines.zh: 但对某一特定的人来说——一天过去了,她仍紧紧扒着我脑海的墙壁……

lines.en: Well, I bet it’s exciting for her.
lines.zh: 嗯,我敢打赌这对她来说很刺激。

lines.en: Or terrifying.
lines.zh: 或者很吓人。

lines.en: Or she’s too busy trying to figure out what’s going to happen next to even be bothered with something as trivial as club reorganization.
lines.zh: 又或者她正忙着搞清楚接下来会发生什么,根本顾不上去操心社团重组这种鸡毛蒜皮的事。

lines.en: But the fact of the matter is-
lines.zh: 但事实是——

lines.en: And I say this with whatever pieces of humanity I have both gained and lost over the last 48 hours-
lines.zh: 而我这句话,是用过去 48 小时里我所获得、也所失去的、仅剩的那些人性碎片说出来的——

lines.en: I hope she enjoys it.
lines.zh: 我希望她能享受它。

lines.en: I hope we all enjoy it.
lines.zh: 我希望我们都能享受它。

lines.en: And I know that we won’t.
lines.zh: 而我知道我们不会。

lines.en: But I hope that we do.
lines.zh: 但我希望我们会。

lines.en: : Senpaiiiiiiiiiiiii...
lines.zh: : Senpaiiiiiiiiiiiii……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 干嘛?

lines.en: : My girls are leaving the nest! I’m never going to see them again!
lines.zh: : 我的姑娘们要离巢了!我再也见不到她们了!

lines.en: : You’re going to see them tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 你明天就能见到她们。

lines.en: : Tomorrow is Saturday and I’m going out drinking!
lines.zh: : 明天是星期六,我要出去喝酒!

lines.en: : Then...you’re going to see them on Monday.
lines.zh: : 那……你星期一就能见到她们。

lines.en: scene clubtime17
: Yeah. I guess that’s true.
lines.zh: : 是啊。好像也是。

lines.en: : Hey, do you have any idea how the whole...club advisor thingy works? Because they told me I had to sign up to be one, but all that was left when I went to do it was light music and swimming.
lines.zh: : 嘿,你知道那个……社团顾问的事儿是怎么运作的吗?因为他们跟我说必须报名当一个,可等我去报名的时候,只剩下轻音和游泳了。

lines.en: : Which means you’re probably going to get stuck with music since I chose the latter.
lines.zh: : 也就是说你大概会被塞给音乐那边,因为我选了后者。

lines.en: : I’m...actually the advisor for a club already.
lines.zh: : 我……其实已经是一个社团的顾问了。

lines.en: scene clubtime18
: What? Really? Which one?
lines.zh: : 什么?真的?哪一个?

lines.en: : Holy shit.
lines.zh: : 我操。

lines.en: : You’re a closet otaku, aren’t you? I knew something was up.
lines.zh: : 你是个隐藏的御宅族,对吧?我就知道有鬼。

lines.en: : I’m not...but that does happen to be the club I’m apparently in charge of.
lines.zh: : 我不是……不过那刚好就是我似乎负责着的社团。

lines.en: : In terms of knowing how it works, though...I have absolutely no idea. So just ask Wakana when you go get drunk and have a lesbian threesome or whatever.
lines.zh: : 至于它怎么运作……我完全没有头绪。所以你去喝醉、搞什么女同性恋三人性爱之类的到时候,直接问 Wakana 吧。

lines.en: : Do you think they’ll invite me? I don’t have as much threesome experience as you. I might disappoint them.
lines.zh: : 你觉得她们会邀请我吗?我的三人性爱经验可没你丰富。我可能会让她们失望。

lines.en: : Please clue me in if they do.
lines.zh: : 如果她们邀请你,记得告诉我。

lines.en: : Roger that, Senpai. Your wish is my command.
lines.zh: : 收到,Senpai。你的愿望就是我的命令。

lines.en: scene clubtime19
: Guess I should probably head out, though. It’ll be hard getting everybody to like me if I bail on the very first club meeting.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概该走了。要是第一次社团活动我就缺席,很难让大家都喜欢上我。

lines.en: : Plus, one of the girls on the team is mad busty and needs a new swimsuit, so I’ve gotta track that down and whatnot so her boobs don’t pop or something.
lines.zh: : 再说,队里有个姑娘波霸得不行,需要一件新泳衣,所以我得去找找什么的,免得她的胸蹦出来之类的。

lines.en: : That’s...not possible, Imani.
lines.zh: : 那……是不可能的,Imani。

lines.en: : If it is, ain’t like I’ve gotta worry about it. B-life forever, yo.
lines.zh: : 就算可能,也轮不到我操心。B 罩杯人生 Forever,yo。

lines.en: scene clubtime20
: Maybe I’ll drop by later and...make sure you’re doing everything correctly.
lines.zh: : 也许我待会儿会顺道过去……确认一下你每件事都做得对。

lines.en: : That totally isn’t just an excuse I’m making up to see you in a swimsuit, though. This is a purely professional decision I am making as your superior.
lines.zh: : 这绝对不是我为了看你穿泳衣编出来的借口。这是我作为你的上司所做的、纯粹出于职业考量的决定。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not really planning on doing any swimming or anything. Not really into that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我其实不打算游泳什么的。我对那种事不太感兴趣。

lines.en: : You chose a weird club to sign up for, then.
lines.zh: : 那你报了个挺怪的社团啊。

lines.en: : Wait, how come I’m the one who needs to erase this? I didn’t even write it.
lines.zh: : 等等,为什么是我来擦这个?又不是我写的。

lines.en: scene black
scene clubtime21
: Wait, how come I’m the one who needs to erase this? I didn’t even write it.
lines.zh: : 等等,为什么是我来擦这个?又不是我写的。

lines.en: : It was Rin this time...she wanted to leave you a parting gift since she won’t be coming back to the club room any time soon...
lines.zh: : 这次是 Rin 写的……她想给你留个临别赠礼,因为她短期内不会再回社团活动室了……

lines.en: : I tried to stop her, but...I thought it was kind of sweet in a way.
lines.zh: : 我试着拦她了,不过……我觉得那从某个角度来说还挺可爱的。

lines.en: : There is nothing sweet about calling someone a nerd, Futaba. Especially someone who is most definitely not a nerd. Me.
lines.zh: : 管别人叫书呆子,这一点都不可爱,Futaba。尤其那个人绝对不是书呆子。也就是我。

lines.en: : R...Right...
: I’ve got a bad feeling about this, Ami. I couldn’t convince Tsuneyo to join us and we’re only an hour or two away from the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 我有种不祥的预感,Ami。我没能说服 Tsuneyo 加入,而离今天结束只剩一两个小时了。

lines.en: : That’s fine...we’ll make it.
lines.zh: : 没关系……我们做得到的。

lines.en: : I talked to Ayane and Sana and...they’re basically kind of members already. So we just need one of them to become an {i}actual{/i} member and...
lines.zh: : 我跟 Ayane 和 Sana 谈过了,而且……她们基本上已经算是成员了。所以我们只要让其中一个变成{i}真正{/i}的成员,然后……

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 然后……

lines.en: : We’ll definitely be okay.
lines.zh: : 我们肯定没问题的。

lines.en: scene black
scene clubtime22
: Are you...
: Are you sure about this?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗?

lines.en: scene clubtime23
: I want to be cool like you guys!
lines.zh: : 我想变得像你们一样酷!

lines.en: : GAAAAAAH YES. She’s so cute. Can we keep her, Mom? Can we?
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊好!她太可爱了。我们能养她吗,妈?能吗?

lines.en: : What? Why are you looking at me? I’m not your mom.
lines.zh: : 什么?你们看着我干嘛?我又不是你妈。

lines.en: : You’ve got mom energy, though. But like, hot mom. Not normal mom. You know?
lines.zh: : 可你身上有妈妈气场。不过像是,辣妈。不是普通妈妈。你懂的?

lines.en: : Sana...is this really what you want? Do you even know how to play any instruments?
lines.zh: : Sana……这真是你想要的吗?你连乐器会不会弹啊?

lines.en: scene clubtime24
: Well, I...um...I’ve never...really...even {i}had{/i} an instrument, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯,我……呃……我从来……真的……连{i}拥有{/i}过一件乐器都没有,不过……

lines.en: : I...listen to a lot of music and...and I’ve always wanted to try playing the drums.
lines.zh: : 我……听很多音乐,而且……而且我一直都想试试打鼓。

lines.en: : Hey, that’s great! We still need a drummer, right? And it’s not like we’ve got any shows lined up.
lines.zh: : 嘿,那太好了!我们正好还缺个鼓手,对吧?而且我们又没有排好什么演出。

lines.en: : Yeah! We’ve got plenty of time to teach Sana how to play! You can play drums, right Otoha?
lines.zh: : 对啊!我们有的是时间教 Sana!你会打鼓的,对吧 Otoha?

lines.en: : Yeah, but...I don’t know if I’m good enough to really {i}teach{/i} anyone.
lines.zh: : 会,不过……我不知道自己有没有好到真能{i}教{/i}别人。

lines.en: scene clubtime25
: I’ll do my best! I promise!
lines.zh: : 我会尽全力的!我保证!

lines.en: : Mom, pleeeeeeeeeeease?
: Dude, stop. I’m not your mom. I’m not even the club president.
lines.zh: : 老兄,别喊了。我不是你妈。我连部长都不是。

lines.en: : Wait, you’re not?
lines.zh: : 等等,你不是?

lines.en: : Yeah, what? Who else is going to be president? I kind of figured it would be you.
lines.zh: : 啊,什么?那还有谁当部长?我还以为会是你呢。

lines.en: : Can you guys just let me feel normal for a minute and not like some sort of...motherly presidential prodigy? I’ve barely even had time to-
lines.zh: : 你们能让我正常一分钟吗,别把我当成什么……慈母兼天才部长?我连喘口气的工夫都还没——

lines.en: scene clubtime26
: Ya-ho!
: Chika? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : Chika?你在这儿干什么?

lines.en: scene clubtime27
: Joining the light music club.
lines.zh: : 加入轻音部啊。

lines.en: : None of the other clubs really interested me. So when I sat down and tried to narrow down the list...this was kind of the only thing on it.
lines.zh: : 其他社团我都没什么兴趣。所以等我坐下来试着把名单缩小……这差不多是上面唯一剩下的东西了。

lines.en: : Plus, I’ve always wanted to hear Rin play guitar, and now she’ll {i}have{/i} to play for me.
lines.zh: : 再说,我一直都想听 Rin 弹吉他,现在她{i}不得不{/i}弹给我听了。

lines.en: scene clubtime28
: I’m like, an okay singer. And the only experience I have with instruments is the recorder from when they made us play in grade school.
lines.zh: : 我嘛,唱歌也就一般般。而我跟乐器唯一的交集,就是小学时他们逼我们吹的那个竖笛。

lines.en: : So unless you’re looking for a mediocre recorder player or a singer who’s like, maybe a third as good as Otoha, I can probably just sit out and watch or something.
lines.zh: : 所以除非你们要找一个水平普通的竖笛手,或者一个大概只有 Otoha 三分之一好的歌手,那我也许就坐旁边看看什么的。

lines.en: : I’m more of a listener than a player anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我更擅长听,而不是弹。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Hmm...
: Well...we do need five people to make this an official club. And with Sana joining, we’re already at four.
lines.zh: : 那个……我们确实需要五个人才能算正式社团。而 Sana 加入之后,我们已经有四个人了。

lines.en: : What?! Sana! You joined the light music club! That’s so cool! What do you play?
lines.zh: : 什么?!Sana!你加入了轻音部!太酷了!你弹什么?

lines.en: : M-Me?! Umm...uhh...n...nothing yet...
lines.zh: : 我……我?!呃……嗯……还……还没什么……

lines.en: scene clubtime29
: Listen, uhh...
lines.zh: : 听着,呃……

lines.en: : I...don’t really think we need somebody to just...watch us. So unless you wanted to try picking up an instrument or something-
lines.zh: : 我……不太觉得我们需要一个只是……看着我们的人。所以除非你想试着学一件乐器什么的——

lines.en: : Wait! What if...and hear me out here...
lines.zh: : 等等!如果……先听我说完……

lines.en: : What if I became your manager?
lines.zh: : 如果我来做你们的经纪人呢?

lines.en: : Our manager? But we’re not even a band yet. There’s not anything to manage.
lines.zh: : 我们的经纪人?可我们连乐队都还算不上。没什么好管理的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but like...aren’t you super talented, Otoha? And Noriko, your sister is literally my queen. Between you two and Rin, who’s already my friend, where else would I even go?
lines.zh: : 是啊,可是……Otoha 你不是超有才的吗?还有 Noriko,你姐简直就是我的女王。再加上你们俩,还有已经是我朋友的 Rin,我还能去哪儿?

lines.en: : I’m sure I can contribute something. I just want a chance to-
lines.zh: : 我肯定能贡献点什么的。我只是想要一个机会——

lines.en: scene clubtime30
: Yeah!
lines.zh: : 好啊!
: Rin?……

lines.en: : Yeah! Let’s do it!
lines.zh: : 好啊!就这么办!

lines.en: : The four of us can form a band and Chika can be the manager!
lines.zh: : 我们四个组乐队,Chika 来当经纪人!

lines.en: : Aaaah, Rin! Thank you so much! I promise I won’t let you down!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊,Rin!太谢谢你了!我保证不会让你失望的!

lines.en: : I...um...I won’t...let anyone down either!
lines.zh: : 我……呃……我也不会……让任何人失望的!

lines.en: scene clubtime31
: Rin...I don’t really know if this is a good idea...
lines.zh: : Rin……我真不确定这是不是个好主意……

lines.en: : Otoha, it’s fine! We need a fifth member, right? And with a manager, we can focus on playing and leave all of that other stuff to her! This is great!
lines.zh: : Otoha,没事的!我们不是需要第五个成员吗?有了经纪人,我们就能专心演奏,把那些杂事都交给她!这太棒了!

lines.en: : Yeah, I...I get the logistics of it...It’s just...you know...
lines.zh: : 是啊,我……道理我懂……只是……你知道的……

lines.en: : Know what? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 知道什么?怎么了?

lines.en: : Know that...
lines.zh: : 知道那个……

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: scene clubtime32
: Ugh...Nevermind.
lines.zh: : 唉……算了。

lines.en: : Otoha?
lines.zh: : Otoha?

lines.en: : It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没事。

lines.en: : I’m probably just worrying too much.
lines.zh: : 我大概只是想太多了。

lines.en: scene black
scene clubtime33
: Listen up, worms...
lines.zh: : 听好了,虫子们……

lines.en: : You will obey my rules at all times.
lines.zh: : 你们要时刻遵守我的规矩。

lines.en: : You will only speak when spoken {i}to.{/i}
lines.zh: : 只有被{i}问到{/i}的时候才准开口。

lines.en: : But most importantly, you will treat both me...and {i}each other...{/i}with respect.
lines.zh: : 但最重要的是,你们要尊重我……也尊重{i}彼此……{/i}

lines.en: : Do I make myself clear?
lines.zh: : 听明白了吗?

lines.en: scene clubtime34
: Understood!
lines.zh: : 明白!

lines.en: : Ichimonji, is there a problem?
lines.zh: : Ichimonji,有什么问题吗?

lines.en: : There are many problems. None of them really pertain to kyudo, though. So you can keep doing your thing and I’ll keep pretending to care.
lines.zh: : 问题有很多。不过没有一个真的跟弓道有关。所以你继续搞你的,我继续装作在乎。

lines.en: : You’re free to leave whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你想走随时可以走。

lines.en: : In fact, I implore you to do so if you intend to remain as sarcastic and confrontational as that.
lines.zh: : 事实上,如果你打算一直这么阴阳怪气、处处作对,我还恳请你赶紧走。

lines.en: scene clubtime35
: Io, come on! It’s the first meeting. Just go along with it today and stop coming afterward if you don’t like it.
lines.zh: : Io,别这样!今天是第一次活动。今天先顺着来,不喜欢的话以后别来就是了。

lines.en: : Me being here {i}is{/i} me going along with it. I didn’t realize I was going to have to agree to signing my soul and free will away in the process.
lines.zh: : 我人在这儿{i}就是{/i}在顺着来了。我可不知道还得顺便把自己的灵魂和自由意志签出去。

lines.en: : Chill, Greenie. It’s just a formality.
lines.zh: : 淡定,小绿。这只是个形式。

lines.en: scene clubtime36
: Why do you always think it’s okay to talk to me? Let alone give me stupid nicknames like “Greenie.”
lines.zh: : 你凭什么总觉得可以跟我说话?更别说还给我起「小绿」这种蠢外号。

lines.en: : Why do you think it’s okay to be a colossal bitch to the kyudo instructor when all you had to do was say one fucking word?
lines.zh: : 那你凭什么觉得,对着弓道教练当个彻头彻尾的泼妇是没问题的——你明明只要说一个他妈的字就行?

lines.en: : You realize you’re just making problems for yourself, right? And that it’s not the world that’s just against you for no reason whatsoever?
lines.zh: : 你该明白你只是在给自己找麻烦吧?也该明白并不是全世界都在毫无理由地跟你作对吧?

lines.en: : I do. And yet, nothing changes.
lines.zh: : 我明白。然而,什么都没有改变。

lines.en: : Wow, what a mystery.
lines.zh: : 哇,真是个谜呢。

lines.en: : Sorry, Kirin...Io’s just in a bad mood today.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Kirin……Io 今天心情不好。

lines.en: : Io needs to get fucking laid.
lines.zh: : Io 该找人他妈的干一炮了。

lines.en: scene clubtime37
: {i}Do you kiss your mother with that mouth?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你就是用这张嘴亲你妈的吗?{/i}

lines.en: : Nope. Just the guy you like.
lines.zh: : 不。只亲你喜欢的那个男的。

lines.en: scene clubtime38
: You fucking-
lines.zh: : 你他妈的——

lines.en: : Wait. What? Who? Who are we talking about right now? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 等等。什么?谁?我们现在在说谁?怎么回事?

lines.en: scene clubtime39
: Isn’t this just wonderful, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 这难道不是很棒吗,Tsuneyo?

lines.en: : Kyudo is not only a majestic and alluring sport, but a fantastic piece of Japanese culture. Don’t you agree?
lines.zh: : 弓道不只是一项庄严而迷人的运动,更是日本文化中极美妙的一块。你同意吧?

lines.en: : Sure.
: Did you know that my manor has its own, one-of-a-kind, professionally designed kyudojo? My father had it commissioned when I was just a little girl. It’s absolutely spectacular.
lines.zh: : 你知道我家宅邸里有一座独一无二、专业设计的弓道场吗?我还是个小女孩的时候,我父亲就命人建了它。简直壮观至极。

lines.en: : My father taught me how to strangle chickens.
lines.zh: : 我父亲教过我怎么掐死鸡。

lines.en: : Oh!
: Oh, okay!
lines.zh: : 哦,好的!

lines.en: : Some days, if I close my eyes, I can still hear them scream.
lines.zh: : 有些日子,只要我闭上眼睛,还能听见它们叫。

lines.en: scene clubtime40
: Isn’t kyudo just wonderful?
lines.zh: : 弓道是不是很棒?

lines.en: scene black
scene clubtime41
: Okay, everybody! Welcome to swim club! I’m your host, Imani Imai, and joining me today is the team captain, Karin Kanda!
lines.zh: : 好了,各位!欢迎来到游泳部!我是你们的主持人 Imani Imai,今天和我一起的是队长,Karin Kanda!

lines.en: : Um...thank you, Miss Imai.
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢,Imai 老师。

lines.en: : Karin here is sporting a brand new school swimsuit that I personally handed to her just ten minutes ago!
lines.zh: : 这位 Karin 身上穿的,是我十分钟前亲手交给她的全新学校泳衣!

lines.en: : Did you know that they had to have it custom made because she’s the size of an adult woman despite being only-
lines.zh: : 你们知道吗,那件是定做的,因为尽管她才——

lines.en: scene clubtime42
: Hi, everyone! I’m Karin! This is a normal swimsuit! It wasn’t custom made at all! I’m only a little bit taller and...more endowed than the other girls in my grade!
lines.zh: : 大家好!我是 Karin!这是普通的泳衣!根本不是定做的!我只是比同年级的其他女孩高一点点、而且……丰满一点点而已!

lines.en: : Okay, who’s ready to swim?! That’s what we do here! Swim! Yeah!
lines.zh: : 好了,谁准备好游泳了?!我们在这儿就是干这个的!游泳!耶!

lines.en: : Water!
scene clubtime43
: How come Karin’s actin’ so nervous? There ain’t even any boys around and it’s not like she doesn’t have experience with this kinda thing after all that time as the co-captain of the soccer team.
lines.zh: : Karin 咋这么紧张啊?反正又没有男生在,而且她当了那么久足球队副队长,这种事又不是没经验。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see you’re not as torn up over that as you were yesterday, Miku.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你没像昨天那样为那件事崩溃了,Miku。

lines.en: : Oh, I ain’t happy. I’m mad as Hell and I’m not gonna take it anymore.
lines.zh: : 哦,我可没高兴。我气得要死,而且我再也不打算忍了。

lines.en: : But at least I’ve got you two.
lines.zh: : 但至少我还有你们俩。

lines.en: : And I guess swimmin’ ain’t all that bad.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得游泳也没那么糟。

lines.en: : It’s kinda like...playin’ soccer in the water. Just there’s no ball or goal or teammates and all ya do is flail your limbs around and hope ya don’t drown.
lines.zh: : 有点像……在水里踢足球。只是没有球、没有球门、没有队友,你要做的就只是把四肢乱甩一通,然后祈祷自己别淹死。

lines.en: : Yup. Exactly like soccer, Miku.
lines.zh: : 对。跟足球一模一样,Miku。

lines.en: : Oh dear.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : This is far more dangerous than I led myself to believe.
lines.zh: : 这比我原先想的要危险得多。

lines.en: : We’re swimming today...right, Miss Imai? You didn’t just make us put these uniforms on so you could take pictures of us and show them to Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我们今天是要游泳的……对吧,Imai 老师?你该不会只是让我们换上这身衣服,好给你拍照拿去给 Sensei 看吧?

lines.en: : P...Pictures?! Show?! Sensei?! Us?!
lines.zh: : 拍……拍照?!给 Sensei 看?!我们?!

lines.en: : It appears I left my cell phone in the locker room! How unfortunate that you must all now be subjected to two hours worth of fun because of my mistake!
lines.zh: : 看来我把手机落在更衣室了!真不走运,因为我的失误,你们现在都不得不承受整整两个小时的快乐!

lines.en: : Umm...uhh...
: {i}Miss Imai, who is the girl that’s just...staring at me like that?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Imai 老师,那个一直……那样盯着我的女孩是谁?{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, that’s Nodoka. She’s a super genius who habitually undresses everyone with her eyes but doesn’t have the balls to actually make a move on anyone.
lines.zh: : 哦,那是 Nodoka。她是个超级天才,习惯性地用眼神把所有人的衣服扒光,却没那个胆子真的对谁出手。

lines.en: scene clubtime44
: Perhaps I’m just waiting for someone to make a move on {i}me?{/i} Have you ever thought about that, Imani?
lines.zh: : 也许我只是在等有人来对我{i}出手{/i}呢?你想过这个可能吗,Imani?

lines.en: : Not really, no!
lines.zh: : 没怎么想过,没有!

lines.en: : Your day will come, Nodoka. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 你的日子会来的,Nodoka。别担心。

lines.en: scene clubtime45
: Oh, I’m not worried at all.
lines.zh: : 哦,我一点也不担心。

lines.en: : I’ve amassed plenty of opportunities to exchange my virginity for semi-regretful memories over the last several months. I’m just carefully deciding which ones would be the most fun to regret.
lines.zh: : 过去这几个月里,我攒下了大把可以用童贞换取「半后悔回忆」的机会。我只是在仔细挑选,哪些后悔起来会最有趣。

lines.en: : Right now, the most ideal scenario would be for each one of you to take turns sitting on my face. I am ready whenever you are, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 眼下最理想的场景,是你们一个接一个轮流坐到我脸上。我随时都准备好了,Ayane。

lines.en: : I’m good, but thank you for offering!
lines.zh: : 我就不了,不过谢谢你的好意!

lines.en: scene clubtime46
: Hey, uhh...
: This is where the...swim club thing meets, right?
lines.zh: : 游泳部……是在这儿集合吧?

lines.en: : Yumi?...
lines.zh: : Yumi?……

lines.en: : Are you...actually joining the club?
lines.zh: : 你……真要加入这个社团?

lines.en: scene clubtime47
: Looks that way, four eyes.
lines.zh: : 看起来是这么回事,四眼。

lines.en: : Well, fall into line and pretend to be prepared, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那就归队,装作准备好了的样子吧,我猜。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re finally participating in something, but if you showed up on time you would have realized that you were supposed to wear-
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你终于肯参加点什么了,不过你要是准时到,就会知道你本该穿——

lines.en: scene clubtime48
: Yeah, yeah, yeah. I’m late and unprepared. Story of my life.
lines.zh: : 行行行。我迟到了,还没做准备。我的人生一贯如此。

lines.en: : Just be happy I’m actually doin’ this shit by choice and that nobody forced me this time.
lines.zh: : 你就知足吧,这次可是我自己选的,没人逼我。

lines.en: scene clubtime49
: The fuck are you gonna do?
lines.zh: : 你他妈想怎么样?

lines.en: : Me?
: {i}I{/i} am going to wait.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}打算等。

lines.en: : Wait for what, Einstein? For me to look away so you can try to sucker punch me with those fuckin’ noodle arms?
lines.zh: : 等什么,爱因斯坦?等我移开视线,好让你用那两条他妈的面条胳膊偷袭我?

lines.en: : You’ll know when it’s time.
lines.zh: : 时候到了你自然就知道了。

lines.en: : Oooh, intimidating.
lines.zh: : 哦哦,好吓人哦。

lines.en: scene clubtime50
: You’re going to have to show up on time from now on, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 从今往后你得准时来了,Yumi。

lines.en: : If somebody else was in charge of this club, I wouldn’t bat an eye. But there are a lot of expectations on me as a student teacher, and the fact that I’m even {i}allowed{/i} to advise a club is-
lines.zh: : 如果换别人管这个社团,我眼皮都不会抬一下。可作为一名实习老师,我身上背的期待很多,而我能被{i}允许{/i}指导一个社团这件事本身——

lines.en: : Got it, yeah. I don’t need your background story. I’ll show up on time from now on.
lines.zh: : 懂了,行。我不需要你的心路历程。以后我会准时的。

lines.en: : Only reason I was late is cause I was lookin’ for my school swimsuit, but I ain’t ever used it before so...yeah. No fuckin’ clue where it is.
lines.zh: : 我迟到只是因为在找我的学校泳衣,可我从来没用过,所以……是啊。完全他妈不知道在哪儿。

lines.en: scene clubtime51
: Oh. Well...okay. Yeah, that works.
lines.zh: : 哦。那个……好吧。行,没问题。

lines.en: : Just come with me and we’ll find one in your size, I guess. Karin and the others can just start without you. All we were going to do was hang out and get to know each other today anyway.
lines.zh: : 跟我来吧,我给你找一件合身的。Karin 她们可以先开始。反正我们今天本来也就是聚一聚、互相认识一下。

lines.en: : I’ll get in the water and shit, but...I ain’t really good at that whole “Gettin’ to know each other” BS.
lines.zh: : 水我会下的,可是……我实在不擅长那种「互相认识」的破事。

lines.en: : Well...you’ve gotta start somewhere. But it’ll be hard to start anything dressed like that, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……总得有个开始。不过穿成那样很难开始什么,所以……

lines.en: : Let’s see what we can find for you.
lines.zh: : 看看能给你找着什么吧。

lines.en: scene black
scene clubtime52
: We are doomed. This is the end of the manga club.
lines.zh: : 我们完了。漫画部要走到尽头了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry it had to end like this. But if we are to blame someone, I suggest we scapegoat Nithhala and her quest to become a normie.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾会以这种方式收场。不过如果要找个人背锅,我建议让 Nithhala 来,因为她非要走上成为现充这条路。

lines.en: : I could have sworn at least {i}somebody{/i} was going to show up.
lines.zh: : 我敢发誓至少{i}会有谁{/i}来的。

lines.en: : How much time is left until we have to submit the club roster?
lines.zh: : 离提交社团名单还有多少时间?

lines.en: : We could always just read in one of the dorm rooms. It’s not like we {i}need{/i} this club room or anything.
lines.zh: : 我们大可以随便找间宿舍房间读书。反正我们也{i}不是非要{/i}这间活动室。

lines.en: : In fact, to be honest, I’d {i}prefer{/i} we move somewhere else. Specifically somewhere without a dry erase board that the three of you will use to write untrue things about me.
lines.zh: : 事实上,说实话,我{i}更希望{/i}我们换个地方。具体点说,换个没有白板的地方——免得你们三个在上面写我的不实之词。

lines.en: scene clubtime53
: The door! It’s opening! Someone is here!
lines.zh: : 门!门开了!有人来了!

lines.en: : Someone is...
lines.zh: : 有人是……

lines.en: : Someone is...!
lines.zh: : 有人是……!

lines.en: scene clubtime54
: Someone is...Yasu?
lines.zh: : 有人是……Yasu?

lines.en: : Hello...
lines.zh: : 你们好……

lines.en: : I would like to join your club please.
lines.zh: : 我想加入你们的社团,拜托了。

lines.en: : Sorry. Applications are-
lines.zh: : 抱歉。申请已经——

lines.en: scene clubtime55
: Welcome aboard!
lines.zh: : 欢迎加入!

lines.en: : Oh, god damn it.
lines.zh: : 哦,真他妈的。

lines.en: scene black
scene clubtime56
The day comes to an end and the hateful summer heat reaches me before anyone else.
lines.zh: 这一天走到了尽头,而那可恨的暑气比任何人都更早地追上了我。

lines.en: I leave school knowing that all of the girls I would normally leave {i}with{/i} are off experiencing the early stages of new and exciting things without me.
lines.zh: 我离开学校,心里清楚那些平时会{i}跟我一起{/i}走的女孩,此刻都正在没有我的地方,体验着新鲜而刺激的事物的最初阶段。

lines.en: Without me.
lines.zh: 没有我。

lines.en: Without me, who is meant to be the center of their lives and affection and the target of all of their desires.
lines.zh: 没有我——那个本该是她们生活与感情的中心、是她们所有欲望的靶心的人。

lines.en: But strangely enough, I am okay with that.
lines.zh: 但奇怪的是,我对此并不介意。

lines.en: In this fleeting moment filled with mental gymnastics in which I tell myself I am not burning alive, I accept the prospect of being alone so long as I am alone under my own conditions.
lines.zh: 在这个转瞬即逝、充满自我说服的瞬间里,我一边告诉自己我并没有在活活燃烧,一边接受了「孤独」这个前景——只要这份孤独是按我自己的条件来的。

lines.en: What those are is hard to say.
lines.zh: 那些条件到底是什么,很难说清。

lines.en: But this is just one day of what I feel will be a very long summer.
lines.zh: 但这只是一个漫长夏日中的一天。

lines.en: And this is just one tangential slope I must descend on the way back to dismissive complacency.
lines.zh: 这也只是我必须走下去、回到那种无所谓式的自满之中的其中一道切线斜坡。

lines.en: The day comes to an end and the hateful summer heat reaches me before anyone else.
lines.zh: 这一天走到了尽头,而那可恨的暑气比任何人都更早地追上了我。

lines.en: scene black
I wonder what the night will bring?
lines.zh: 不知道今夜会带来什么?

lines.en: {i}Congratulations!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜你!{/i}

lines.en: {i}You are free once more!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你又一次自由了!{/i}
